description: This Java source file defines the GroovyEngine class, a service engine for executing Groovy scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages script execution, context setup, and error handling for Groovy-based services.

classes.name: GroovyEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that executes Groovy scripts as service implementations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createProtectedKeys
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable set of protected keys that should not be written to by scripts, such as 'dctx', 'dispatcher', 'delegator', and 'visualTheme'.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides the method to run a service synchronously and ignore its result, delegating to runSync.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a Groovy script service synchronously, setting up the script context, handling script invocation, and managing exceptions.
